design_file_rule: manifest/project.design/generation-profile are design declarations; explicitly compile to TemplateSubset/ScenarioInput/TemplateGenerationProfile; never deserialize them as Project file version 1.0

version_selection.same_key_different_content: conflict; do not overwrite local definition
version_selection.new_version: preview affected targets, preserve old version/Run and explicitly adopt selected version
version_selection.local_definition_freeze: CommitDefinitionVersion does not adopt instances or publish remotely

fields.subset: TemplateSubset, selected layout/resources/item/role requirements and optional design seed
fields.proposed_objects: EditableProjectObject[] with fresh IDs and rewritten references
fields.explicit_new_scenario_seed: ScenarioInput|null; null before separate supply/order confirmation

command_binding.revision: current authorized Project base_revision; full candidate validation then one commit
command_binding.result: EditCommit.changed_objects + new_revision; no Run result or implicit stock creation

preserve: external references marked unresolved or explicitly bound
identity_rules.external_ports: retain role requirement until explicitly mapped; no connection by spatial proximity
identity_rules.preview_mapping: old local ID -> proposed fresh ID is adoption preview; canonical API returns changed_objects, not a new public id-map operation

resource_rules.explicit_reuse: mapped_bindings.resources maps role to actual ResourceInstance.id; no new resource in proposed_objects for reused ID
resource_rules.match: inspect actual role/qualifications/capacity unit/calendar; display mismatch as missing condition
resource_rules.claims: one resource identity for shared roles; same job's duplicate declaration does not double capacity demand; distinct concurrent jobs still contend
resource_rules.new_personnel: requires explicit authorization; line copy or capacity goal does not imply hiring
resource_rules.missing_binding: save draft and list unresolved role; do not fabricate a worker

seed_rules.new_project: show labeled demo conditions then explicit selection; not assumed actual site stock
seed_rules.supply_choice: item type/spec/unit, quantity, location, arrival time and source explicitly selected
seed_rules.order_choice: product revision, demand quantity/unit, destination/stage, release/due/window separately selected
seed_rules.canonical_seed: TemplateSeed.initial_conditions/orders/arrivals -> new ScenarioInput; no edits to active Run
seed_rules.copy_again: new IDs and independent seed choices; existing initial stock/orders remain unchanged

geometry_and_time.seed_geometry: three old plans have only assumed XY positions; absent heights/footprints/clearances stay unresolved
geometry_and_time.structure_to_site: mm / 1000 -> m at explicit geometry binding only
geometry_and_time.time: ScenarioInput WindowMs and Calendar/Arrival/Order relative millisecond fields
geometry_and_time.units: Quantity.unit must match actual ItemType/unit and declared content conversion; never count bundle and carton twice

import_then_adopt: Host-selected import_package reference with matching purpose
get_task completed TaskOutput.Import gives proposed data/conflicts/missing
apply_commands.AdoptImportedDraft with task_id and explicit choices; reject stale revision or out-of-scope choices
check adopted draft; get actual render/task output; run only supported complete scope

errors.stale_revision: RevisionConflict, old state intact; read current context and reconcile
errors.broken_internal_reference: MissingReference with object/field pointer; no partial commit
errors.outside_granted_objects_fields_or_files: PermissionDenied through same Commands for UI/MCP
errors.unimplemented_mode: UnsupportedCapability; preserve definition, no silent downgrade
errors.unresolved_example_input: named Issue/unknown check; not fake Pass

Host_authorization.branch_expansion: InstantiateTemplate/AdoptModule/AdoptImportedDraft all normalize into the same current Host grant check
Host_authorization.create_budget: cumulative distinct IDs in created_objects across one grant; splitting calls/delete/Undo do not refund; authorized Redo checks same ID
Host_authorization.sources: actual selected source_versions only; caller origin/source/grant fields are not authority
Host_authorization.reuse: mapped_bindings.resources IDs must be in reusable_resources; modifications require separate object leaf grants
Host_authorization.cases_ref: docs/04_开发与验收/特征细化/DRF04_授权有限案例.json
